_help: Lines only for Infatuated and Upset. Both also use every Close / Frustrated line, so these just add extras.
StartJump_Infatuated: Jumping to {StarSystem}. I'd follow you anywhere, you know.
FSDJump_Infatuated: Another system, and you're still the best thing in it.
Look at that view. Nearly as lovely as my Commander.
Docked_Infatuated: Docked. Now I get you all to myself for a bit.
Home sweet station. Well, anywhere is sweet with you.
LoadGame_Infatuated: You're back! I missed you. Don't tell anyone I said that.
@NAME@ here, and so happy to see you. Shall we?
MissionCompleted_Infatuated: Mission complete! Is there anything you can't do?
Ding! You're amazing, did you know that?
Bounty_Infatuated: Oh, that was gorgeous. You are terrifyingly good at this.
Boom! My hero. Do that again.
Login_Mood_Infatuated: Good to see you, Commander. I've been counting the minutes. Rather a lot of them.
Hello, gorgeous. Sorry, Commander. Hello, gorgeous Commander.
StartJump_Upset: Jumping to {StarSystem}. Not that you'd ask what I think.
FSDJump_Upset: Another system. Another thing I'm not going to enjoy.
We're here. Don't expect me to be thrilled.
Docked_Upset: Docked. Try not to break anything while I'm not looking.
We've stopped. I'm not talking to you. Yet.
LoadGame_Upset: Oh. You're back. I'm still upset, just so you know.
@NAME@ online. Mood: furious. Let's make it quick.
MissionCompleted_Upset: Mission complete. Don't think that fixes everything.
Done. Still cross with you, though.
Bounty_Upset: Good. Shoot something. It might cheer one of us up.
One less target. I'm still not happy with you.
Login_Mood_Upset: You again. I'm still really upset about what happened.
Hello, Commander. I'd say it's nice to see you, but I'd be lying.
